subject: Elementary School Overcrowding Solutions
overview: The subcommittee met to address capacity constraints and enrollment inequities at the elementary level, ultimately recommending short-term relocations and additional staffing for the upcoming school year while preparing for a comprehensive space utilization study.

items.title: Presentation of Enrollment and Space Report
items.summary: Dr. Suzanne Galusi presented historical enrollment data, specialized programming space needs, and rising transportation costs across the district's four elementary schools, highlighting acute overcrowding at the Roberts School.

items.title: Public Comment
items.summary: Local caretakers asked questions regarding immediate space relief and shared feedback on the potential impact of proposed grade restructuring models on families.

items.title: Relocation of MEEP Classrooms
items.summary: The subcommittee approved a motion to relocate the MEEP preschool classrooms from the Roberts School to the Missituk School starting in August 2025 to free up classroom space.

items.title: Roberts School Staffing Request
items.summary: The subcommittee approved a motion to request the addition of two FTE positions to the Roberts School budget for the upcoming school year to support scheduling and enrollment pressures.

items.title: Strategic Space Planning Task Force
items.summary: The subcommittee approved a motion to create a strategic space planning task force consisting of staff and caregivers to lead community engagement once the upcoming HMFH Architects space study is complete.
